info.name: Skilljar Assets Domains > Signup Fields API

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

items.docs: Manage signup fields for a domain. Signup fields define the information collected from users during the signup process for a specific domain. Each field may have a set of options, validation rules, and display properties. Use this endpoint to view the list of signup fields configured for a domain.
